precedence: Apply these bindings and transition guard replacements to the archived source catalogue for the reconciled planning view. Preserve the original workflow ID and accepted historical version; do not compile an uncorrected source and corrected binding as two independent writers.
commonGuards: Server-derived business/location and actor scope, granted action, supported capability and complete applicable setup are mandatory on every command path, including staff/admin, Local API, imports and background work.
An exact accepted offering, configuration/workflow/policy revision, expected entity version and stable idempotency/operation reference accompany each mutation.
Instant, held, merchant-approval and external-confirmation are reservation-intake routes, not universal work states. Each route requires actual supported authority and compatible resources.

NEXG-controlled required allocations succeed or fail together. External-controlled allocations remain pending until confirmed by their owner; no claim of atomicity across independent provider transactions.
Finance prerequisites apply only where the accepted policy requires them, and use the correct payment authority. Acceptance, payment, reservation, fulfilment and refund are independent facts.
One root work identity and explicit allocation roles prevent a parent, child, calendar mirror or retry from reserving or charging the same requirement twice.
Kenya local entry/display uses Africa/Nairobi. Timed commitments retain UTC instants; date-only promises remain local dates. No merchant timezone question.
Missing or stale authoritative capacity is unknown, not free. Read-only or unsupported external capability cannot confirm a local reservation.
Post-commit delivery/sync/payment tasks use durable transactional records and idempotent workers; a pre-commit hook is not permission to send irreversible effects.

stateRules.meaning: Order, enquiry, quote, entitlement or tentative work has not reserved time/capacity. Do not create a blocking Payload pending reservation merely to store this work.
Operation pending. Preserve last confirmed allocations; request receipt is not a hold.

stateRules.capacityEffect: confirmed hold quantities block until trusted expiry/release/confirmation
stateRules.meaning: Hold ID, exact scope and authority-confirmed expiry required; native Payload hold mechanism is mapped by the adapter.

stateRules.capacityEffect: only existing confirmed holds remain blocking
stateRules.meaning: Confirmation request may be pending externally; never infer RESERVED from the request alone.
The owning authority confirmed durable capacity and all policy prerequisites for this commitment.
Attendance, custody, occupancy or execution evidence controls physical use; elapsed scheduled time alone is insufficient release evidence.

stateRules.capacityEffect: last confirmed allocated/in-use quantities remain blocking
stateRules.meaning: Cancellation or return request remains pending until actual release is confirmed.
Authority confirms release; financial outcome remains independent.

stateRules.capacityEffect: only an authoritatively expired temporary hold is released
stateRules.meaning: A browser countdown, payment timeout or end of planned physical-use interval is not trusted release.

routes.guard: Supported atomic reserve-and-confirm command and all declared prerequisites; no fabricated temporary hold.
Actual supported holds, valid expiry and conversion under the same allocation owner; avoid releasing then recreating the same capacity unprotected.
A verified external response confirms the reservation/resource reference. A local mirror does not become a second authority.

payloadProjection.workRequests: Store nonblocking business requests/quotes/entitlements in NEXG work records, not blocking reservation rows.
payloadProjection.holds: Map HELD to the inspected plugin's actual hold mechanism and expiry semantics; verify exact native representation at implementation.
payloadProjection.reservations: Use one common configured Payload reservation lifecycle and explicitly declare blocking statuses. Each blocking row has real allocation roles and quantities. Upstream pending status must never be a catch-all for enquiries.
payloadProjection.completion: Work completion and allocation release are coordinated facts, not a universal status alias. Do not let a generic completed/cancelled plugin status release an asset still physically out or goods still stored.
payloadProjection.externalMirrors: Keep externally confirmed identity and capacity semantics distinct from NEXG-owned allocations; do not double-count an imported owner fact plus its Google mirror.

bindings.reservationSemantics: No time reservation by default. Stock remains inventory-owned. An explicitly selected scheduled fulfilment window is an allocation role on the same order, not a fabricated appointment or mandatory paired pickup-return child.
Accepted production workload and due promise are typed commitments. A due date is not a provider appointment start; optional fitting/handoff has a separate declared allocation role.
Reserve exact eligible resources before confirming the customer commitment. Venue and customer-location execution are mutually exclusive per booking; a linked field child reuses allocations.
Remote method of a real provider reservation. Session access is separately authorized and is not a physical-room allocation or completed consultation.
A scope approval is not a confirmed arrival/resource promise. Team, equipment and travel constraints are confirmed by the allocation owner before a firm visit is shown.
At customer confirmation, exact vehicle/asset and any contracted driver requirement are jointly reserved. Later dispatch assignment refers to already guaranteed allocations.
Confirmed transport requires jointly guaranteed eligible driver and vehicle capacity. Greeter-only offering uses its explicit greeting graph and allocates no invented transport.
Place/seat/ticket quantities consume a shared dated occurrence pool. Ticket issue, admission and completion remain separate from reservation confirmation.
Attendee reservations consume places; instructor/venue/equipment allocations belong once to the occurrence or declared requirement. Go/no-go clearance is a separate operational decision.

Private intervals and shared departure places use declared resources and supplier authority. Quote approval alone does not reserve a tour. Customer confirmation requires all contracted local and supplier allocations plus relevant policy prerequisites.
Enquiry and quote acceptance are nonblocking. Accepted commitment creates supported resource allocation only once; advisory work with no resource booking remains valid without an appointment.

Firm turnaround promises reserve feasible collection/processing/return roles at commitment. Assessment-required work shows later return as indicative until actual workload/price/promise is approved. Later transport-dispatch confirmation reuses the existing promise.
Entitlement activation consumes no future session slots by itself. An explicitly approved occurrence creates actual child work and uses its own authoritative reservation and one-time credit use.
Quotes are nonblocking. Carrier/controlled capacity is confirmed for actual cargo dimensions, leg and units; no interchangeable guest-count proxy.
Typed occupancy applies across the entire accepted interval. Physical custody and partial release reconcile remaining quantities; scheduled end alone cannot mark uncleared goods as absent.

Administrative enquiry/provider handoff only. Preserve the regulated-enquiry work graph rather than forcing a quotation, financial transaction or appointment. A consultation is a separately enabled offering.
bindings.modelLifecycleOverride: Preserve WF_REGULATED_ENQUIRY lifecycle; REQUEST_QUOTE supplies only nonblocking intake/authority semantics, not compulsory commercial quotes.

bindings.reservationSemantics: Queue/intake, assessment, timed bay/provider work and promised completion are distinct. Mobile child execution reuses the accepted parent scope and allocations without a second charge.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Current price, eligibility and order acceptance confirmed; configured payment prerequisite separately satisfied. If acceptance includes a firm chosen delivery/collection window, that window's authority-confirmed allocation or explicit request-only result must be recorded. Ordinary order acceptance has no appointment requirement.
additionalGuards: Do not create an independent root booking/charge for the fulfilment-window role.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Approved specification/price revision, authoritative materials and typed production-capacity/due commitment confirmed; any policy-required Finance pre-start prerequisite is separately satisfied.
additionalGuards: Changed due date/workload requires a new feasibility check and accepted material changes.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Qualified team, actual equipment, customer area/access, exact arrival/service/travel interval and all required capacity allocations confirmed together; any payment prerequisite required at firm visit confirmation is separately satisfied.
additionalGuards: APPROVED remains scope acceptance until this firm promise exists; no automatic field child from an onboarding answer.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Exact Kenya pickup/return interval, asset eligibility, maintenance/turnaround and actual resources available; hold all required roles together, including qualified driver capacity when the selected rental offering includes a driver.
additionalGuards: The hold records role IDs and trusted expiry; a source fleet-size band is not capacity.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: All contracted asset and driver allocations are durably confirmed together for the whole interval before the hold expires; accepted contract/eligibility checks and only the deposit/payment prerequisite actually required by policy are confirmed.
additionalGuards: With-driver rental cannot become a confirmed customer commitment while driver capacity is still unreserved.
A driver-capacity pool is allowed only with an implemented guaranteed allocation/eligibility policy; free-form later assignment is insufficient.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Selected offering includes a driver and driver capacity is already durably reserved for the entire rental. This is operational assignment/acknowledgement for the existing allocation, not a request to discover capacity after confirmation.
additionalGuards: Any resource substitution is a guarded atomic swap that preserves a valid original commitment on failure.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Actual qualified driver is bound to the already guaranteed allocation and accepted interval; reserved asset, driver eligibility and handover prerequisites remain valid.
additionalGuards: Do not create a second rental/transfer allocation or charge.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Selected transport offering has accepted route, passenger/luggage constraints, pickup interval and price/quote; all required eligible driver/vehicle capacity and any policy-required payment prerequisite are authoritatively confirmed together.
additionalGuards: A class-pool assignment requires an implemented guaranteed reservation policy; otherwise reserve actual eligible resource identities before confirmation.
Greeter-only offerings use VAR_TRANSFER_GREETER_ONLY rather than passenger journey states.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Dispatcher binds or acknowledges actual eligible driver/vehicle against the existing guaranteed reservation and accepted trip. A permitted substitution preserves allocation invariants and any affected customer terms.
additionalGuards: This transition is not the first resource-availability check and must not double-reserve the trip.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Valid held ticket/seat/place quantities convert to durable reservation under the shared occurrence pool before expiry; eligibility and only configured payment prerequisites are confirmed.
additionalGuards: Ticket types and passes obey declared shared pool/occurrence scope; issuer reference is separate.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Participant count, exact occurrence and place/equipment capacity available; required occurrence-level instructor/venue/equipment allocations are confirmed once or held with the occurrence under the declared policy.
additionalGuards: Do not add a new exclusive instructor reservation for every attendee in the same session.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Held participant quantities convert to durable occurrence reservation before expiry; required consent/eligibility and only configured payment prerequisites are separately confirmed. Required occurrence resources are valid.
additionalGuards: Place confirmation is distinct from a later minimum-participant/weather go decision; disclose the accepted contingency policy.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Each contracted third-party component has an authoritative confirmation reference, all required NEXG-controlled departure/guide/vehicle/equipment allocations are durably confirmed, and only policy-required Finance prerequisites are satisfied. Unresolved commitments remain pending and visible.
additionalGuards: Acceptance of an itinerary or an inclusion checkbox cannot imply a supplier allocation.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: No third-party supplier commitment exists in accepted scope; exact shared/private departure places, eligible guide/transport/equipment and other internal resource allocations are confirmed together and any configured payment/clearance prerequisites pass.
additionalGuards: Shared and private offerings cannot independently consume the same guide/vehicle capacity.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Actual incoming method, location, interval and actor confirmed. For FIRM_PRE_ACCEPTED promise mode, collection/processing/return commitments are jointly feasible and reserved under accepted exact scope. For ASSESSMENT_REQUIRED mode, only the selected incoming leg is committed; later price/return is explicitly indicative until assessment and customer acceptance.
additionalGuards: No return promise is displayed as confirmed from the incoming-leg confirmation alone.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Exact measured scope, price version and turnaround/return promise accepted; required typed processing and return-window capacity is authoritatively confirmed, reusing already valid incoming allocations and preserving custody facts.
additionalGuards: If a previously firm promise is materially affected, route change review rather than silently revising accepted time/price.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Exact fixed scope/price was accepted, no measured reassessment is required, and processing/return commitments are authoritatively reserved or confirmed against the existing firm promise.
additionalGuards: Customer drop-off does not create a collection trip.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Actual outgoing method, actor, location and dispatch/collection interval confirmed against the accepted feasible return commitment. Reuse the promise's allocation roles; any material change requires guarded revision and customer acceptance.
additionalGuards: This is operational leg confirmation, not the first validation of a return promise already sold to the customer.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Explicit commercial plan, accepted scope/validity and authoritative entitlement confirmed; only the configured enrollment payment or separate recurring mandate prerequisite is required. No session capacity is consumed by activation alone.
additionalGuards: Legacy recurrence/subscription interest cannot independently authorize plan renewal or debit.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: An actual accepted recurring occurrence is requested under a supported child offering; entitlement validity/credit and exact scope pass, child allocation authority confirms its reservation, and credit usage plus local allocation is coordinated atomically or through explicit external reconciliation. Idempotency uses membership plus occurrence identity.
additionalGuards: The entitlement remains separate from occurrence execution and payment; no automatic duplicate child/charge.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Actual carrier/leg reference, typed cargo dimensions/quantity/units and all controlled capacity constraints are authoritatively confirmed, with accepted quote revision and any configured pre-booking payment prerequisite.
additionalGuards: Mass/volume/container quantities cannot be converted to interchangeable guest counts; source capacity failure remains unknown.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: Accepted typed quantity/unit/precision, compatible goods, exact location and full occupancy period fit authoritative capacity throughout the interval; required approval/payment policy is satisfied separately.
additionalGuards: No implicit sqm/sqft conversion or rounded capacity increase.

transitionOverrides.replacementGuard: All goods have actual authorized final release/custody evidence and the capacity owner confirms released quantity. Financial adjustments remain separate. Planned occupancy end or billing period alone cannot close physical custody.
additionalGuards: Overstay/uncleared goods create a visible occupancy exception and effective blocking constraint; do not display the resource as free because the scheduled end elapsed.

variants.activation: Explicit selected fulfilment method supports customer-selected windows and has a declared capacity owner.
variants.executionRule: Window belongs to the existing order/root work; use a linked carrier leg only if that actual method requires it. A single delivery/collection window is not automatically a paired laundry workflow.

variants.activation: Walk-ins explicitly offered; scheduled bookings accepted and advance booking mandatory are separate inputs.

additionalTransitions.guard: Atomic current eligible resource allocation and any applicable consent/payment policy pass; customer actually arrived. No advance booked slot is fabricated.

variants.executionRule: Walk-ins share underlying resources with scheduled bookings. Queue-only services do not expose instant slot confirmation.

variants.activation: Selected eligible rental offering includes driver service.
variants.executionRule: Driver capacity is guaranteed at rental confirmation. Later assignment/acknowledgement is execution readiness, not a new independent transfer.

variants.activation: Meet-and-greet offering explicitly declares transport not included; missing transport mode requires clarification.

transitions.guard: Greeter eligible capacity for exact meeting/wait interval is durably confirmed and accepted terms plus configured payment prerequisite satisfied.
Actual greeter binds the already confirmed allocation; substitution is guarded.
Assigned greeter confirms actual departure under agreed meeting plan.
Actual correct meeting point and time recorded.
Correct authorized customer met; only minimum necessary identity/contact evidence retained.
Contracted greeting/assistance completed; allocation release and any unresolved waiting/no-show exception recorded.

variants.executionRule: No vehicle, boarding or destination milestone. If transport is included, use the passenger-transfer graph and jointly allocate vehicle/driver.

variants.activation: Selected laundry/processing offering has declared actual incoming/outgoing methods and price confirmation policy.
variants.executionRule: Reserve each firm role when its promise becomes accepted; show indicative versus confirmed return explicitly. Customer dropoff/collection bypasses carrier milestones.

newWorkflowDeclarations.reason: A party/table reservation needs a compatible-space allocation and seated/turnover lifecycle; do not silently reuse staff appointment semantics.
newWorkflowDeclarations.activation: Explicit bookingSetup.offers_table_reservations=true, compatible table/space inventory and party policy, exact duration/turnover, completed setup and supported reservation authority. Existing reservation_system discovery does not activate this workflow.

transitions.guard: Compatible actual table/space set fits party and exact interval/turnover; authority confirms all combination allocations and trusted hold expiry together.
Valid hold converts to durable compatible-space reservation before expiry; accepted terms, approval and only configured payment prerequisites satisfied.
Instant intake actually supported; atomically reserve all compatible spaces and pass every configured prerequisite without fabricating a temporary hold.
External authoritative provider confirms exact space/party/time and durable reference through a verified adapter; local mirror is not another writer.
Correct reservation/date and actual party arrival recorded; a no-show decision is not inferred from elapsed time alone.
Actual assigned compatible spaces are ready and party changes fit capacity; a reassignment is an atomic guarded swap.
Actual party departure recorded; configured cleaning/turnover remains a blocking constraint.
Required turnover evidence and owner-confirmed release permit availability; dining completion does not fabricate order/payment completion.

registrationDependencies: SPACE_RESERVATION offering fields and view binding

ORDER.note: Separate stock/order flow. Optional chosen fulfilment window uses its own declared allocation and owner.

APPOINTMENT.note: Instant/held/external routes require actual supported reservation authority. Walk-in-only must not advertise future slots.

FIELD_VISIT.note: Instant is possible only with exact known scope, coverage, travel and resource capacity; otherwise request/approval.

ASSET_INTERVAL.note: All contracted asset/driver capacity and policy gates must be satisfied before confirmation.

TRANSFER.note: Confirmed trip/greeting requires the actual model's joint resource guarantee.

SESSION_CAPACITY.note: Actual dated capacity and occurrence setup are required. Arrival allocation shares the same pool.

SPACE_RESERVATION.note: Compatible table/space allocation, party policy and turnover required; walk-ins still need valid current allocation.

TOUR.note: Instant applies only to a supported fully configured published offering with confirmed controlled/supplier inventory; supplier enquiry is never instant confirmation.

PRODUCTION_DUE.note: Specification/workload/due commitment needs explicit acceptance; instant published variants require a future reviewed capability rather than default enablement.

REQUEST_QUOTE.note: Submission is nonblocking. Approved work may later select a supported commitment model. Regulated administrative enquiries preserve their specific review graph.

LINKED_WINDOWS.note: Instant firm promises require known exact workload and feasible paired capacity; assessment-required mode cannot confirm an unknown return.

SERVICE_JOB.note: A separately offered intake/work appointment uses APPOINTMENT; the entire diagnostic job is not automatically instant bookable.

ENTITLEMENT.note: Plan enrollment is not a reservation-intake mode. Actual sessions use their own models and supported modes.

FREIGHT.note: Declared cargo, carrier scope and capacity are confirmed before booking; no generic instant freight mode.

STORAGE.note: Typed goods/unit/period compatibility and custody policy need acceptance; future instant storage needs explicit reviewed capability.

exceptionMaterialization.scope: For each exception binding, add cancellation request edges from each listed source to pendingState using requestCommand, and one pendingState-to-cancelledState edge using confirmCommand and its guard. Add listed hold/quote expiry and noShow edges with the named command/guard. Register added states explicitly and deduplicate any identical existing edge.
exceptionMaterialization.defaultRequestGuard: Current actor, accepted policy and workflow/config version permit requesting cancellation; preserve every last-confirmed allocation and custody fact while the owning authority resolves it.
exceptionMaterialization.holdExpiryGuard: Trusted allocation owner confirms expiry of this exact temporary hold and release; never use browser time, a late callback or expiry of a planned physical-use interval as release evidence.
exceptionMaterialization.quoteExpiryGuard: Current unaccepted exact quote version passed its declared expiry according to trusted time. Expiry changes no already-confirmed allocation or accepted scope.
exceptionMaterialization.quoteExpiryRecovery: A fresh quote requires a new quote version and customer approval; do not silently revive the expired price.
exceptionMaterialization.holdExpiryRecovery: Offer a new current availability request with a new hold identity. An expired hold cannot be silently resurrected or displace a later commitment.
exceptionMaterialization.outcomeUnknown: An unknown provider result remains an operation state; do not advance the confirmed business state or release capacity. Reconcile by stable operation/provider reference.

cancellation.confirmGuard: Order and inventory/fulfilment owners confirm permitted cancellation and releasable stock/window quantities. Already transferred custody uses the supported return/recovery process, not this pre-handover edge; refund remains separate.

Accepted cancellation/change terms and actual production/material/custody position reviewed; owner confirms released future workload and preserves incurred work, goods and financial decisions separately. Cancellation cannot erase produced goods or handover custody.

Booking/allocation owner confirms permitted cancellation and release of applicable unperformed reservation; linked field execution and actual physical state are reconciled, and payment/refund outcome stays separate.

noShow.guard: Applicable arrival/attendance deadline passed, actual non-arrival verified and authorized decision recorded under accepted policy; allocation release is separately confirmed.

cancellation.confirmGuard: Booking owner confirms allowed unperformed session cancellation and allocation/access revocation; already delivered content/interruption uses its actual workflow. Financial outcome remains separate.

noShow.guard: Valid authorized session access was available, participant absence was verified after configured deadline and authorized provider decision recorded; a failed session link is not a customer no-show.

cancellation.confirmGuard: Owning service/allocation authorities resolve actual travel/site state and accepted cancellation terms, confirm releasable future resources and preserve any already incurred work/fees and custody facts; no fabricated refund or completed service.

Rental owner confirms permitted pre-issue cancellation and release of asset/driver roles; an already issued asset follows early-return/custody recovery rather than being marked free. Deposit/refund is separate.

noShow.guard: No asset handover occurred, pickup grace and accepted policy permit decision, and authorized rental authority records non-arrival. Release of asset/driver roles must be confirmed; payment handling is independent.

cancellation.confirmGuard: Transfer authority confirms allowed cancellation against actual travel/boarding state and accepted policy, releases only available future roles and preserves already incurred travel and separate financial outcome. After boarding, use journey/interruption recovery.

noShow.guard: Driver actual arrival and agreed waiting allowance recorded; authorized absence decision under accepted policy, no passenger boarded and role-release result separately confirmed.

cancellation.confirmGuard: Booking/issuer authorities confirm allowed cancellation, unused admission entitlement revocation and correct occurrence/ticket pool release. Issuer unknown stays pending; refund remains separate.

noShow.guard: Configured admission cutoff and authorized attendance evidence establish no admission; do not release or reissue already consumed tickets or fabricate a refund.

cancellation.confirmGuard: Activity owner confirms allowed participant cancellation or occurrence cancellation, correct place quantities and occurrence-owned resources. Cancelling one attendee cannot release an instructor still needed by the session; refunds remain separate.

noShow.guard: Activity actually cleared to run, configured arrival deadline and real absence evidence permit an authorized decision. Do not mislabel an occurrence cancelled by the operator as participant no-show.

cancellation.confirmGuard: Tour and all relevant allocation/supplier authorities confirm cancellation scope and results under accepted terms; partial/unknown provider results remain visible and do not imply all inventory released or refunds paid. On-tour disruption uses travel-exception recovery.

noShow.guard: Departure is genuinely ready, agreed arrival/wait policy passed and authorized guide/operator confirms absence; shared departure resources remain owned by the occurrence.

cancellation.confirmGuard: Coordination authority resolves accepted scope and any supplier/child commitments; pending provider outcomes are reconciled, actual releasable allocations confirmed and financial decisions kept separate. Uncommitted requests release no invented capacity.

Processing/transport/custody authorities confirm permitted work cancellation and releasable promises. Goods already held require a separately owned return/recovery record with retained custody/allocations until actual handoff. Do not erase held goods, fabricate carrier completion or mark refund paid.

Entitlement owner confirms accepted effective cancellation and relevant billing authority confirms required mandate changes. Existing booked occurrences retain their own change rules; a plan cancellation does not silently erase their capacity commitments.

Carrier and freight owners confirm permitted pre-collection cancellation and released cargo/leg capacity. Actual collected/in-transit custody requires an explicit carrier intercept/return workflow and cannot be cleared by this edge. Fees/refunds are separate.

Storage owner confirms permitted pre-intake cancellation and exact typed occupancy release. After goods intake, follow authorized retrieval/custody workflow; scheduled end or cancelled billing cannot make physically occupied space free.

Enquiry/provider authority confirms permitted withdrawal of this administrative enquiry, preserving required restricted history. This does not cancel or reverse a separately owned financial/professional transaction and releases no invented appointment.

Job/parts/custody/field owners resolve accepted cancellation terms, actual diagnostic work and releasable resources. Customer goods require return-unrepaired or another explicit custody recovery; an already active service follows its controlled interruption/change policy. Financial outcomes stay separate.

Space owner confirms permitted pre-seating cancellation and release of exact table combinations; any refund is separately confirmed. Occupied spaces follow actual departure and turnover, not a generic cancellation release.

noShow.guard: Actual non-arrival, accepted grace period and authorized host decision establish no-show; release of compatible spaces follows owner policy and never displaces a seated party.

exceptionContract.policy: The source catalogue names many exceptions in prose. These definitions require registered owner commands and explicit valid source-state lists for each final compiled workflow. They are not generic permission to jump from any state.

cancellation.guard: Actor/policy/current work state permit the request; preserve all last-confirmed allocations and custody facts until owner result.

Owning work/reservation authorities confirm cancellation and releasable quantities. In-use assets or custody require an explicit return/recovery process; a cancellation cannot erase physical use. Any refund remains separately authorized and confirmed.
Retain original confirmed state and stable operation identity; explain rejection or reconcile unknown provider outcome before retry.

reschedule.guard: Check accepted change terms, price/scope revision, current version and eligible replacement resources.
For local allocations switch old/new commitments atomically; for external authority use supported change/compensation contract. A failed change retains the valid original commitment.
Preserve original valid allocation and reconcile uncertain provider results; never blindly release and rebook.

exceptionContract.expiry: Only verified temporary hold expiry releases held quantity. Accepted quotes may expire without allocation effects. Physical overstay becomes an exception requiring continued actual unavailability and resolution, not automatic release.
exceptionContract.noShow: Meaningful only for applicable attendance/arrival workflows, after configured deadline and authorized decision. Release policy, fee/refund state and occurrence attendance are distinct.
exceptionContract.configurationChange: New onboarding/configuration revisions apply to new work after publication. Existing accepted work retains its configuration, workflow, quote and policy version unless an explicit accepted migration/change is performed.
